title: 第90章 剑帝传承第89章 九叶还魂
content_zh:
三天后。
陈牧能下床了。
九叶还魂草的效果比医修长老预想的更好——不仅修复了天道之力的侵蚀，还增强了陈牧的体质。凡体少年走起路来虎虎生风，右臂上的伤口已经结痂，只剩一道浅粉色的疤痕。
"将军——"陈牧站在医馆门口，右拳攥得紧紧的，"我好了。"
顾渊看着他。看着那个三天前还躺在病床上、脸色苍白如纸的少年——现在站在那里，像是一棵经历过风暴后更加坚韧的树。
凡体。最普通的体质。没有灵根。没有天赋。没有——
任何超凡的力量。
但陈牧站起来了。
用最普通的身体。用最顽强的意志。用——
九千四百九十万拳的坚持。
"嗯。"顾渊说。
"你要走了。"陈牧说。
不是问句。是陈述句。
顾渊没有回答。但他的沉默——就是回答。
"葬剑秘地。"陈牧说，"传承。"
两个字。
顾渊转过头。看向陈牧的眼睛。
那双眼睛不聪明。不深邃。没有萧无痕的推演能力，没有龙惊天的战意燃烧——
但那双眼睛里——有一种——说不出来的东西。
信任。无条件的信任。

"去吧。"陈牧说，"我守这里。"
"等你——带着传承回来。"
顾渊伸出手。拍了拍陈牧的肩膀。
那只手上有茧。有伤痕。有四年挥剑千万次留下的痕迹——
但那只手——是温暖的。
"嗯。"他说。
陈牧笑了。那个憨厚的、沉默的、总是用行动代替言语的少年——笑了。
"将军——"他说，"你救了我一命。"
"我知道——你不求回报。"
"但——"
"我会还的。"
"用我这条命——"
"守你。"
顾渊沉默。
三息。
"不用。"他说。
"用。"陈牧说。
两个字。很简单。但——是承诺。
顾渊的嘴角动了一下。那是一个笑。
"好。"他说。

朱八斗在厨房里。
content_en:
Three days later.
Chen Mu can get out of bed.
The effect of the Nine-leaf Resurrection Grass was better than the medical elder expected - it not only repaired the erosion of the power of heaven, but also enhanced Chen Mu's physique. The mortal boy walked vigorously, and the wound on his right arm had scabbed over, leaving only a light pink scar.
"General——" Chen Mu stood at the door of the medical center, clenching his right fist tightly, "I'm fine."
Gu Yuan looked at him. Looking at the boy who was still lying on the hospital bed three days ago, his face as pale as paper - now standing there, like a tree that has become stronger after experiencing a storm.
Mortal body. The most common physique. No spiritual roots. No talent. No——
Any extraordinary power.
But Chen Mu stood up.
Use the most ordinary body. Use the strongest will. Use——
The persistence of 94.9 million punches.
"Yeah." Gu Yuan said.
"You have to leave." Chen Mu said.
Not a question. It's a declarative sentence.
Gu Yuan didn't answer. But his silence - was the answer.
"The secret place where the sword is buried." Chen Mu said, "Inherited."
Two words.
Gu Yuan turned his head. Look into Chen Mu's eyes.
Those eyes are not smart. Not profound. Without Xiao Wuhen's deduction ability, without Long Jingtian's burning fighting spirit——
But there was something indescribable in those eyes.
trust. Unconditional trust.
"Go." Chen Mu said, "I'll guard here."
"Waiting for you to come back with the inheritance."
Gu Yuan stretched out his hand. He patted Chen Mu on the shoulder.
There is a callus on that hand. There are scars. There are traces left behind by swinging the sword tens of millions of times over four years——
But that hand - it was warm.
"Yeah." he said.
Chen Mu smiled. The honest, silent boy who always used actions instead of words - smiled.
"General—" he said, "you saved my life."
"I know—you ask for nothing in return."
"But-"
"I'll pay it back."
"With my life——"
"Guard you."
Gu Yuan was silent.
Three breaths.
"No need," he said.
"Use." Chen Mu said.
Two words. Very simple. But - it's a promise.
The corners of Gu Yuan's mouth moved. That's a laugh.
"Okay." he said.
Zhu Badou is in the kitchen.
